systems.name: AnimalAnimation
systems.summary: Advances the clip of every Animal, blends it with the clip it fades from, and writes the joints, world and skinning matrices into its AnimalPose.

access.name: Animal
access.effect: Species and clip read; time, fade and previous_time advanced; an out of range clip reset to -1.

access.name: AnimalPose
access.effect: Emplaced when missing; local, world and skin overwritten by evaluate().

access.name: AnimalLibrary
access.effect: Emplaced and loaded when missing; species loaded lazily into its cache.

access.name: Executor
access.effect: Optional taskflow executor that evaluates the poses in batches of 16.

side_effects: Reads resources/animals/library.json and each species' .json, .bin and .anim on first use.
Logs the library's size or absence, and each species that fails to load.
Runs taskflow tasks (batches of 16 animals when there are more than 32) and waits for them.

systems.name: AnimalGait
systems.summary: Procedural walk: animals with an AnimalGait that play a walk, trot or run clip get their pose bent along their path and their feet planted on the ground; sets the clip's rate to the speed over the ground.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Where the animal is: speed, turn and the world frame of the feet.

access.name: Animal
access.effect: Species, clip and time read; rate written.

access.name: AnimalGait
access.effect: Style (replaced by the override when on), feet, phase, period, speed, turn, bend, drop, model, weight.

access.name: AnimalPose
access.effect: World matrices read, bent and planted; skin rewritten; local left as the clip's.

access.name: GaitModels
access.effect: Cache of analyseGait per species and clip.

access.name: GaitStyleOverride
access.effect: Style forced on every animal while on.

access.name: AnimalLibrary
access.effect: The species of each animal.

access.name: GroundField
access.effect: The ground the feet are planted on (std::shared_ptr).

access.name: TerrainGenerator
access.effect: The terrain, when there is no ground field (std::shared_ptr).

side_effects: Logs one line per species and gait clip analysed.
Queries the ground field several times per foot per frame.

systems.name: SteeredWalk
systems.summary: Walks kinematic animals with an AnimalSteer toward the heading and speed asked, on the ground, and picks their idle, walk or run clip; keeps a SteeredWalk until they halt once unsteered.

access.name: AnimalSteer
access.effect: Heading, speed and run asked.

access.name: SteeredWalk
access.effect: Emplaced on newly steered animals, walker state advanced, removed once halted without steering.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Heading read at the start; position and rotation written over the ground.

access.name: HerdAnimal
access.effect: The speed the herd had the animal walking, to start from.

access.name: AnimalBotProxy
access.effect: Proxies of physical animals are left to AnimalBotSteer.

access.name: Animal
access.effect: Species read; clip played, rate written.

access.name: AnimalGait
access.effect: With one, the rate is left to AnimalGait.

access.name: AnimalLibrary
access.effect: Species, length and clips.

access.name: GroundField
access.effect: The ground walked on (std::shared_ptr).

access.name: TerrainGenerator
access.effect: The terrain when there is no ground field (std::shared_ptr).

side_effects: Adds and removes the SteeredWalk component, which Herds watches to let go of and take back its members.
Queries the ground field per walking animal per tick.

systems.name: AnimalBotSteer
systems.summary: Keeps a host AnimalBotProxy (Transform and AnimalPose) for each world's physical animal and turns an AnimalSteer on it into the bot's WalkCommand within its trained ranges.

access.name: Worlds
access.effect: The scene's worlds and their registries.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: Body, ranges and segment states read; command.wanted_speed, wanted_turn and until written.

access.name: AnimalBotProxy
access.effect: One per world, filled at creation.

access.name: AnimalBotProxy
access.effect: Proxies destroyed with their entity.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Created with the proxy; position and rotation overwritten every tick.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Destroyed with the proxy entity.

access.name: AnimalPose
access.effect: Emplaced when the species is in the library; world overwritten.

access.name: AnimalPose
access.effect: Destroyed with the proxy entity.

access.name: AnimalSteer
access.effect: Heading and speed asked of the proxy.

access.name: AnimalLibrary
access.effect: Species index and skeleton of the body.

side_effects: Creates one proxy entity per world with a built animal, destroys them in finish.
Writes into other registries: the AnimalBot command of each world, read at the next world step.

systems.name: Herds
systems.summary: Herds anchored to cells of the world, spawned around the viewer, grazing and moving on over the ground, around trunks, letting go of steered members.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Members' made, placed on the ground every tick (read when steered), destroyed with them; plants' read for trunks.

access.name: Animal
access.effect: Species, clip and time set at spawn; clips played and rate set; destroyed with the member.

access.name: HerdAnimal
access.effect: Kind and cell at spawn; moving and speed every tick; removed from steered members when the herd goes.

access.name: AnimalGait
access.effect: The procedural walk's style, when procedural.

access.name: AnimalGait
access.effect: With one, the rate is left to AnimalGait; destroyed with the member.

access.name: AnimalPose
access.effect: Destroyed with the member.

access.name: AnimalSteer
access.effect: A steered member is let go, not waited for, not destroyed.

access.name: SteeredWalk
access.effect: The same while it coasts to a halt.

access.name: Plant
access.effect: Trunks to walk around.

access.name: HerdStats
access.effect: The herds of this frame.

access.name: HerdSys
access.effect: HerdSys* to this system, for HerdWatch::nearest.

access.name: AnimalLibrary
access.effect: Members' species, sizes and walk clips.

access.name: Camera
access.effect: The viewer, without centre.

access.name: GroundField
access.effect: The ground (std::shared_ptr).

access.name: TerrainGenerator
access.effect: The ground without a field and the slope of the land (std::shared_ptr).

access.name: ForestField
access.effect: Forest cover for the kinds' where (std::shared_ptr).

access.name: VegetationLibrary
access.effect: Height of the plants' species.

side_effects: Reads the herd definition JSON under ./resources/ in init.
Creates and destroys member entities as the viewer moves (destroying every component on them).
Logs warnings for missing members, an error for a bad definition, an info line at init, a debug line per herd spawned.
Queries the ground field per member per tick and the generator's heightfield for slopes.

systems.name: HerdWatch
systems.summary: Puts the desktop camera round the nearest (or asked for) herd at standing height, following it and keeping out of tree crowns.

access.name: HerdStats
access.effect: The herds of this frame.

access.name: HerdSys
access.effect: HerdSys*: nearest() for a kind that is far.

access.name: Camera
access.effect: Position read to choose a herd; position, yaw and pitch written.

access.name: Plant
access.effect: Trees around the herd.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Where the trees are, their scale.

access.name: VegetationLibrary
access.effect: Height and crown radius of the species.

access.name: AnimalLibrary
access.effect: Herds of the cells around a far kind.

access.name: GroundField
access.effect: The ground under the camera and along the sight line (std::shared_ptr).

access.name: TerrainGenerator
access.effect: The ground without a field (std::shared_ptr).

side_effects: Moves the desktop camera every tick once it has a herd.
Logs the herd it chose.
Queries the ground field up to ten times a tick.

systems.summary: Puts the animals of the library in rows on the ground, small ones in front, each playing its clips in turn (scene animals_test).

access.effect: One entity per animal, on the ground.

access.name: Animal

access.name: Animal
access.effect: Clip read; next clip played, rate set to 1.

access.name: AnimalShow
access.effect: The clips to play; index and time left advanced.

access.name: AnimalLibrary

systems.name: AnimalWalkers
systems.summary: Animals side by side walking circles, eights, weaves or straight lines over the ground, with the procedural walk, the camera optionally round one (scene animals_gait).

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Made at init; heading read on the first step, position and rotation written; the followed one read.

access.name: AnimalWalker
access.effect: Path, radius, speed; yaw, travelled, height and pitch advanced.

access.name: AnimalGait
access.effect: The style, with procedural.

access.name: AnimalLibrary

access.name: Camera

access.name: GroundField
access.effect: The ground walked on (std::shared_ptr).

access.name: TerrainGenerator

side_effects: Creates one entity per animal in init.
Logs missing species or walks and each animal's clip, speed, radius and place.

components.name: Animal
components.summary: An animal of the library next to a Transform (uniform scale): which clip it plays and the cross fade from the previous one.

fields.name: species
fields.desc: Index in AnimalLibrary::entries.

fields.name: clip
fields.desc: Index in the species' clips, -1: the bind pose.

fields.name: time
fields.desc: Seconds in the clip.

fields.name: rate
fields.desc: Playback speed (1).

fields.name: in_place
fields.desc: True: the clip's root motion is taken out, the Transform moves the animal.

fields.name: previous
fields.desc: The clip it fades from, -1 for the bind pose.

fields.name: previous_time
fields.desc: Seconds in that clip.

fields.name: previous_rate
fields.desc: Its playback speed.

fields.name: fade
fields.desc: Seconds since the change.

fields.name: fade_duration
fields.desc: Seconds of the cross fade.

components.notes: play(next, seconds = 0.3) starts a clip with a cross fade (no-op when it already plays). Made by Herds, AnimalLineup, AnimalWalkers, MountSpawn, AnimalAgentView and others; AnimalAnimation advances it, AnimalPass draws it.

components.name: AnimalPose
components.summary: The joints of an animal now: local poses, model space matrices and skinning matrices.

fields.name: local
fields.desc: Each joint relative to its parent (translation, rotation, scale), the clip's.

fields.name: world
fields.desc: Model space matrices of the joints (bent and planted by AnimalGait).

fields.name: skin
fields.desc: world times inverse bind: what AnimalPass uploads.

components.notes: Emplaced by AnimalAnimation on every Animal whose species loads; AnimalGait rewrites world and skin; AnimalBotSteer writes world only on its proxies. Read by AnimalPass, riders (saddle), AnimalAgentView.

components.name: AnimalLibrary
components.summary: Index of resources/animals (library.json) and the species loaded on first use.

fields.name: directory
fields.desc: The library folder.

fields.name: entries
fields.desc: Per animal: id, name, height, length, width, joints, triangles, lods, clips, walk clip name, walk_speed.

fields.name: loaded
fields.desc: (private) species loaded so far.

fields.name: failed
fields.desc: (private) species that failed to load, logged once.

components.notes: Made by animalLibrary(reg) on first use, loaded from animalsDirectory() (./resources/animals, else the source tree's); empty when there is no library. species(index) loads on the main thread; loadSpecies and loadGeometry are static and thread safe.

components.name: AnimalStats
components.summary: Counts of the animals drawn this frame, written by AnimalPass, read by the debug menu and the captures.

fields.name: animals
fields.desc: Animal entities.

fields.name: drawn
fields.desc: Drawn on the desktop target.

fields.name: triangles
fields.desc: Triangles drawn.

fields.name: joints
fields.desc: Skinning matrices sent this frame.

fields.name: species_loaded
fields.desc: Species on the GPU.

fields.name: species_loading
fields.desc: Asked for and not drawn yet: captures wait for 0.

components.notes: Renderer side; no system of this folder touches it.

components.name: AnimalShow
components.summary: On an animal of AnimalLineup: the clips it plays one after the other.

fields.name: clips
fields.desc: Clip indices to play, empty: the bind pose.

fields.name: at
fields.desc: Index of the current one.

fields.name: left
fields.desc: Seconds of the current clip left.

components.notes: Made and advanced by AnimalLineup only.

components.name: AnimalGait
components.summary: On an animal: it walks procedurally whenever it plays a gait clip; the style asked and the state AnimalGait keeps.

fields.name: style
fields.desc: How it walks: stride, step_height, clearance, soft_depth, sink_time, exit_vertical, entry_vertical, exit_part, body_sink, crouch, spread, bend, max_bend, head_lead, bank, turn_step, ik.

fields.name: feet
fields.desc: Per leg: planted, placed, position (where planted or left), target (where it lands), now (where it is), ground height, seconds since it landed.

fields.name: model
fields.desc: Clip the pose came from, -1: no gait this frame.

fields.name: weight
fields.desc: 0: the clip, 1: the procedural walk (fades in over 0.3 s).

fields.name: phase
fields.desc: Phase of the cycle, 0..1.

fields.name: period
fields.desc: Seconds of a cycle now (clip's, stretched to the speed).

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: m/s along the heading.

fields.name: turn
fields.desc: rad/s.

fields.name: bend
fields.desc: Radians between hind and fore legs.

fields.name: drop
fields.desc: Metres (model space) the body came down for the legs to reach.

fields.name: last_position
fields.desc: Transform position at the last tick.

fields.name: last_yaw
fields.desc: Heading at the last tick.

fields.name: started
fields.desc: False: the feet are placed again from the clip.

components.notes: Made with a style by Herds (procedural), AnimalWalkers, tests; written by AnimalGait through proceduralWalk. Presence tells SteeredWalk and Herds to leave the clip rate to AnimalGait.

components.name: GaitStyleOverride
components.summary: When on, every animal walks with this style (the debug menu).

fields.name: on
fields.desc: Override active.

fields.name: style
fields.desc: The style forced on every AnimalGait.

components.notes: Emplaced and edited by the debug menu (view/systems/debug_menu.cpp); read by AnimalGait.

components.name: GaitModels
components.summary: Gait models (analyseGait) of the species' clips, analysed on first use.

fields.name: models
fields.desc: Per species and clip index: legs, period, speed, ground, hips, anchors, valid / problem.

components.notes: Emplaced by AnimalGait in preinit; get() analyses and logs on first use. Keyed by species pointer: valid while the library keeps the species.

components.name: AnimalWalker
components.summary: An animal that walks a path of its own (straight, circle, eight, weave, or free), moved by stepWalker.

fields.name: path
fields.desc: Straight, Circle, Eight, Weave, Free (turn set by whoever drives it).

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: m/s.

fields.name: radius
fields.desc: Of the circle, of each loop of the eight, of the bends of the weave.

fields.name: turn
fields.desc: Radians a metre to the left (Free).

fields.name: yaw
fields.desc: Heading, radians about +y.

fields.name: travelled
fields.desc: Metres walked.

fields.name: height
fields.desc: Ground height under it.

fields.name: pitch
fields.desc: Lean with the slope, radians.

fields.name: placed
fields.desc: Put on the ground once.

components.notes: Component of AnimalWalkers' animals; also embedded in SteeredWalk (Free path), GaitWalk and the demonstrations.

components.name: HerdAnimal
components.summary: On each animal of a herd: its herd and whether it walks.

fields.name: herd
fields.desc: Index of its herd's kind.

fields.name: cell
fields.desc: Cell of the world its herd belongs to.

fields.name: moving
fields.desc: It walks.

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: m/s over the ground.

components.notes: Made by Herds at spawn; removed (the entity kept) when the herd despawns while the animal is steered. SteeredWalk starts from its speed.

components.name: HerdStats
components.summary: The herds of this frame, written by Herds.

fields.name: herds
fields.desc: Herds spawned.

fields.name: animals
fields.desc: Their members.

fields.name: moving
fields.desc: Members walking.

fields.name: travelling
fields.desc: Herds on their way to another place.

fields.name: list
fields.desc: Per herd: cell, kind name, centre (on the ground), extent, animals, travelling.

components.notes: Emplaced in Herds' preinit, rebuilt every tick. Read by HerdWatch, CameraWalk and the debug menu.

components.name: HerdSys
components.summary: Pointer to the Herds system, for describe() and nearest().
components.notes: Stored as HerdSys* (insert_or_assign in Herds' preinit); valid while the system lives. HerdWatch calls nearest(kind, from, reach, home) through it.

components.name: AnimalSteer
components.summary: An animal that goes where someone tells it (a rider): heading, speed and run.

fields.name: yaw
fields.desc: Heading asked, radians about +y (0 looks down -z).

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: m/s along it, 0 stands.

fields.name: run
fields.desc: The gait asked: kinematic animals play their run clip.

components.notes: Added and written by the riding systems (Mounting, MountSteering). While present, Herds lets go of the animal; SteeredWalk walks kinematic animals, AnimalBotSteer turns it into a physical animal's command on its proxy.

components.name: SteeredWalk
components.summary: The walk of a steered kinematic animal, kept until it has halted after its AnimalSteer went.

fields.name: walker
fields.desc: Free path: speed and turn from the steering.

fields.name: acceleration
fields.desc: m/s^2, the eased change of speed.

fields.name: yaw_rate
fields.desc: rad/s.

fields.name: walk_speed
fields.desc: m/s of the last walk asked.

fields.name: running
fields.desc: It plays its run.

components.notes: Made, advanced and removed by SteeredWalk. Herds treats its presence like AnimalSteer.

components.name: AnimalBotProxy
components.summary: The host's stand-in for the physical animal of a world: a Transform at its trunk and an AnimalPose of its ragdoll.

fields.name: world
fields.desc: Index of the world in Worlds.

fields.name: species
fields.desc: Index in the library, -1 when not in it.

fields.name: walk_speed
fields.desc: m/s of the body's walk.

fields.name: top_speed
fields.desc: m/s of the fastest order its policy was trained with.

components.notes: One per world, made and destroyed by AnimalBotSteer; Mountables / Mounting make it rideable. SteeredWalk excludes it.

components.name: AnimalSkin
components.summary: On an Animal that is only the skin drawn on something else (a world's ragdoll), not an animal to meet.
components.notes: Set by AnimalAgentView (view/animal_view.cpp); the riding systems (logic/player/mount.cpp) skip it.
